verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party automatic pull-request review feature: nothing reviews each PR automatically and posts contextual feedback on it. What exists are building blocks: headless CLI runs in GitHub Actions, a manual one-off command that pipes a git diff into Cline for review, and cron-scheduled 'code reviews'. A cron schedule is a recurring timer, not a per-PR trigger, so these are adjacent primitives a developer would have to wire up, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
